title: Bicycle task suite
goal: Verify bounded steering, powered chain transmission, and rear-wheel-driven straight ground rolling with a passively rolling front wheel.

profiles.title: Standard two-wheel bicycle
profiles.description: A steerable front assembly, a two-to-one chain-driven rear wheel, and finite front/rear wheel contact with a visible guided upright rolling fixture.

scenarios.title: Steering sweep
execution_requirements: Apply bounded torque only to the steering rigid group and measure its continuous steering angle.
Derive the public bounded steering target directly from the frozen continuous_rotation_rad requirement.
Compare physical and ideal-reference steering traces and audit unintended penetration at every physical step.

scenarios.title: Powered chain-drive roundtrip
execution_requirements: Actuate only the crank/input shaft; never actuate the rear output shaft directly.
Exclude initial engagement from powered rotation and ratio measurement.
Check powered-window samples and adjacent increments, retain zero-input passive return, and audit moving chain-path contact and penetration at every step.

scenarios.title: Rear-wheel-driven ground roll
execution_requirements: Use the supplied bicycle ground-contact template; the design AI must not author a replacement task or joint definition.
Apply task torque only to the rear wheel while leaving the chassis free along the ground travel axis and the front wheel unactuated.

Use native finite Coulomb contact for both wheels. Require two declared axle Revolute bearings, one visible-fixture Prismatic guide, and one straight-ahead steering task lock; hidden rolling, no-slip, gear, or motion-prescription links are forbidden.
Bind both wheel radii, both axle contact heights, and the finite ground plane to the submitted STEP geometry before physics starts.

Record all five body poses, front and rear wheel angles, chassis travel, contact counts, contact coverage, finite-surface separation, slip, drift, off-axis error, penetration, and complete wrench provenance at every saved step.
Show the same full-machine motion in both the interactive physical replay and the certificate replay.

parameters.description: The visible guide leaves straight-line chassis travel unconstrained.
No hidden fixture or support may be used.
The guided test does not claim unassisted bicycle balance.

tasks.title: Steering sweep
tasks.goal: Reach the approved steering angle and compare physical steering motion with the ideal reference.

criteria.description: The steering rigid group reaches at least 0.35 rad in either approved direction.

failure_diagnostics.description: The steering group did not reach the approved minimum angle.
The steering joint stopped before the approved sweep was reached.
The steering group detached or drifted off its authored axis.

evidence_obligations: Measure steering angle from pose_6d in both required branches.
Do not invent a return-to-home tolerance that the frozen task does not specify.

tasks.title: Powered chain-drive roundtrip
tasks.goal: Drive only the input shaft, verify rear output rotation and fixed ratio, then verify passive return.

criteria.description: The powered rear output accumulates at least 2.8 rad after initial engagement is excluded.
The signed rear-output-per-input angular ratio is 2.0 within 0.02.
After input removal, the rear output returns within 0.25 rad of its start position.
The rear output is driven indirectly through the chain and is never directly actuated.

failure_diagnostics.description: The rear output did not reach 2.8 rad in the powered window.
The powered chain ratio was outside 2.0 plus or minus 0.02.
The rear output did not return within 0.25 rad after input removal.
The rear output received forbidden direct actuation.

evidence_obligations: Preserve powered-window and adjacent-increment ratio evidence.
Preserve zero-input passive return, wrench provenance, moving chain-path state, and per-step collision evidence.

tasks.title: Rear-wheel-driven ground roll
tasks.goal: Apply torque only to the rear wheel, translate the chassis over finite ground, and rotate the front wheel passively through contact.

criteria.description: The unactuated front wheel accumulates at least 5.0 rad during the powered window.
The bicycle chassis travels at least 1.50 m along the approved ground axis.
Both wheel-ground contact callbacks are present in at least 90% of saved powered samples.
Maximum powered wheel-ground separation, including distance beyond finite-surface bounds, is at most 0.0002 m.
The powered front-wheel rolling slip ratio is at most 0.12 after the first 0.10 m of travel.
Wheel-ground penetration is at most 0.004 m.
The front wheel is passive and receives no direct task actuation.

failure_diagnostics.description: The passive front wheel did not reach 5.0 rad.
The chassis did not travel 1.50 m.
Paired wheel-ground contact callbacks covered less than 90% of the powered window.
A wheel separated more than 0.0002 m vertically or moved beyond the finite ground bounds.
The front wheel received forbidden direct actuation.
The visible guide or a wheel axle exceeded its public drift bound.

evidence_obligations: Preserve physical and ideal-reference traces with synchronized five-body poses.
Preserve per-step rear/front contact counts, contact coverage, finite-surface separation, slip, axle drift, guide drift, off-axis angle, penetration, and complete wrench audit.
Do not hide any target or threshold from the design AI.
Do not claim unassisted balance, tire deformation, or steering dynamics from this guided test.

source_projects.note: The chain-drive capability remains certified; bounded steering is active, and the new guided ground-roll capability must earn its certificate in the current bicycle run.

approval.basis: Human approval for global reuse was granted in the Codex task for candidate SHA-256 76f8d689bf2d00d2e04cdb9bbc90f7c8ddbae1dd0c038db6d274fb9e5e9cc756. The approved candidate already contained the ground-roll support semantics and public contact gates requiring declared support joints, powered contact coverage, and finite-surface separation evidence. After approval, only approval metadata was added and the embedded ground-contact reference was administratively rebound from the approved candidate joint hash to that joint's catalog-file hash; task and joint semantics and public thresholds are identical to the approved candidates. 2026-08-26: embedded ground-contact reference re-pinned after that joint's provenance attachment; suite tasks, scenarios, and thresholds unchanged.
